recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file browser canvas arcade game titled **Neon Kelp Confidential**. Preserve the protected loop: the game auto-starts, a player avatar sits near the lower screen, pointer/touch/mouse drag moves only the avatar's horizontal target, falling objects spawn from above, collectible objects award +10 score on radius collision, hazard objects end the run on radius collision, pressure increases over distance, and a mobile-safe game-over overlay restarts the same loop.

Rebuild all presentation around a SpongeBob-inspired but original futuristic underwater noir premise. The player is Detective Porifera, a sponge-like private-eye drone with a dark hat and magnifier. Collectibles are glowing clue chips; hazards are pink subpoena mines; score is labeled CLUES; failure is CASE SOAKED. Use procedural canvas art for neon coral skyscrapers, bubbles, plankton specks, lane hints, the sponge detective silhouette, clue chips, and mines. Use a compact HUD with readable noir case-file language and catalog-approved sci-fi audio/fonts/GIF feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first falling-object avoidance and collection arcade game
- objective: steer a bottom avatar horizontally to collect reward objects while avoiding hazard objects
- input model: pointer/touch/mouse down or drag sets a horizontal target; avatar interpolates toward that target; restart is a native button click/tap
- core loop: auto-start play, spawn falling objects, move player left/right, collide with collectibles for +10 score, collide with hazards for game over, restart to reset
- fail/friction state: a hazard collision triggers game-over overlay, hides HUD, stops BGM, shows final score, and offers restart

## Protected Mechanics
- Single canvas runtime with requestAnimationFrame update/draw loop.
- Bottom player position, horizontal-only steering, radius collision checks, falling object cleanup, randomized reward-vs-hazard spawning, +10 collectible scoring, hazard instant fail, distance-based pressure increase, and restart reset are preserved.
- Audio, GIFs, text, colors, entity silhouettes, HUD vocabulary, background art, and feedback copy are themable.

## Remix Target
Neon Kelp Confidential transforms the loop into a futuristic undersea noir detective case: Detective Porifera, a sponge-inspired private-eye drone, sweeps a neon coral alley for clue chips while dodging subpoena mines from a cyber-reef syndicate.
